reference_snapshot.reference_rule: Uses the original Foundation/Spotlight snapshot before the final UI sort. A later mdls probe saw updated dates for running apps and is not treated as a frozen comparison.

mdls_precision_check.meaning: mdls serializes the Spotlight date at whole-second precision. Direct MDItem fractional seconds are not the input used by AppDelete.
mdls_precision_check.later_probe_limit: Running apps changed their metadata after the original snapshot; the later probe is not used to assert the earlier complete order.

special_filename_runtime.comparison_basis: Equivalent fixture basenames in separate temporary roots, not identical scan roots or real-file ownership. Bundles are inert and never installed/executed.

unicode_correctness_comparison.design: Precompiled binaries, ABBA pre-NFC/post-NFC/post-NFC/pre-NFC; identical four-worker scanning and structured coverage reporting. No additional speedup claimed.

scan_coverage_diagnosis.meaning: Failures across common scan roots, not app residual counts. All observed failures were EPERM/EACCES. Count varies as filesystem changes.
scan_coverage_diagnosis.implementation: Return exact path/kind/native cause. Ignore nonexistent optional roots. Fold coverage details separately from candidates. No scan/depth/result cap or permissions change.

validation_current.native_validation: Not performed after prior automatic approval rejection for LocalOps Dev control. Dev-mode workflow retained; no package build.
